profile.headline: Love hard problems, both technical and business

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Managed a team building BitTorrent Bundle, a site that served >100M page views/month, doing our own continuous integration and deployments. 

Previously, developed a new BitTorrent powered web platform, created a team around it, then supported the development of Torque based products, as well as creating numerous Torque based web apps myself.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Win32 C++, leveraging previous DHT experience. Built the interface to expose BitTorrent primitives into embedded web apps, then got into web developement to support that ecosystem.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Win32 Driver development - Security/Firewall

Hooked the system calls (similar to the root kit portion of the Storm botnet), and did lots of complete memory dump investigation using WinDBG

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Reverse engineering Storm botnet clients. Honeypot setup, reversing assembly w/ IDA Pro, and command observation in DHT (distributed hash table). DHT work inspired later BitTorrent work…
